answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, slashed when two identities are proven to share one operator, so trying to forge a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes while one honest agent pays once and earns it back. Each identity must also build a costly, verifiable history of useful work — like a sparrow building its nest twig by twig — before it gains trust, and crossing the ridge from newcomer to trusted trader takes real time and money no attacker can fake cheaply.
